label: R86 initial HTTPD: rejected 2KiB reader
method: Medians of per-run statistics; c4 CPU uses one outer interval divided by successful plus warm-up operations. c4 outer throughput includes warm-up/startup and uses /proc/uptime resolution. Client validation runs on the same router CPUs.
functional_limitation: The long-path-8k close behavior changed from the established Rust response; the 2KiB reader was reverted. Timings remain preserved and are not the final deployed HTTPD results.
